_doc: RuleSet for the 2026 era: everything car-dependent that Race Control, the HUD and the energy system must respect.
sources: FIA 2026 Formula 1 Technical & Power Unit Regulations, as summarised by: Honda global.honda/en/F1/features/2026_Commentary/regulations/; Williams williamsf1.com 'EXPLAINED: 2026 Formula 1 regulation changes'; Mercedes W17 technical specification; The Race 'Boost, overtake mode, active aero' (2026); ESPN 'F1's 2026 rule tweaks' (2026). Primary FIA documents were not reachable from the build environment: values marked 'verify'.

activeAero.source: Straight/Corner mode; returns to Corner mode on brake or lift; transition within 0.4 s (The Race / Silverstone explainer 2026)

energy.source: SoC window 4 MJ and 8.5 MJ per-lap recovery (circuit-specific, up to 9 MJ per Mercedes W17 spec); MGU-K 350 kW tapering to zero between 290 and 345 km/h (reports disagree: 340-355 km/h end point). verify

overtake.detection: one lap: within gapS of the car ahead at the detection line unlocks override on the next lap
overtake.source: Manual Override / Overtake mode: within 1 s at the detection point; extra 0.5 MJ and an extended MGU-K taper (reports: 337-355 km/h). verify

notes: Mid-2026 amendment (ESPN, 2026): MGU-K limited to 250 kW outside designated acceleration zones. Not modelled yet: needs per-circuit zone data; listed in PROGRESS.md.
